name: FeexPay
author: Feexpay

sections.description:
A secure plugin to accept Mobile Money and Credit Card payments.

FeexPay is a plugin designed for Woocommerce that allows you to accept mobile money or credit card payments on your various websites.

As an advantage, this plugin is very easy to use, intuitive and above all requires no integration costs.

Using FeexPay is choosing a fast, secure and reliable way to collect online payments.

Security notice: keep PHP up to date

In October 2026, two critical vulnerabilities were disclosed in the PHP engine itself (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, known as “PHP2Shell”). They allow remote code execution without authentication on any PHP website, whatever plugins are installed. The FeexPay plugin is not the source of these flaws, but a store running a vulnerable PHP version is exposed.

We strongly recommend running one of these PHP versions or later:

  • PHP 8.2.35
  • PHP 8.3.36
  • PHP 8.4.27
  • PHP 8.5.12

PHP 8.1 and older no longer receive security fixes and should be upgraded. You can check your PHP version in WordPress under Tools > Site Health > Info > Server. If needed, ask your hosting provider to update PHP and restart the PHP service.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Fix: customers paying with providers that leave the site (Wave CI, Orange CI, …) are now redirected back to the store, on success and on failure.
  • Fix: the FeexPay transaction reference is no longer replaced by a random value in the return URL.
  • Security: payment status, amount and shop are always verified server-side; the FeexPay reference is stored on the order and never overwritten.
  • Repeated returns (page reload, redirect and notification at the same time) are handled only once.
  • A FeexPay API outage no longer marks the order as failed.

1.1.2

  • Security: an order is only validated if the FeexPay transaction amount and shop match the order.
  • Test mode now verifies payments against sandbox-api.feexpay.me.
  • FeexPay SDK (modal.js) loaded in its latest version.

1.1.1

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.1.
  • Added Congo-Brazzaville (MTN CG) to the country and network settings.
  • Added support for the WooCommerce Checkout block.
  • Payment confirmation now uses WooCommerce’s standard flow (processing status, transaction ID, stock reduced only after payment).
  • A FeexPay transaction reference can no longer be used to pay more than one order.
  • Fixed PHP 8.2+ deprecation notices.

1.1.0

  • WordPress 6.8 compatibility.
  • FeexPay SDK loaded from CDN (modal.js).
  • Fixed sandbox mode always being active.
